title: Law to study requiring household textile recycling
summary: This bill would require the Sanitation Department to study and report, within one year, on the feasibility and environmental effects of requiring households to separate textiles for recycling. The study would examine costs, market demand, potential benefits and drawbacks, and whether a municipal textile recycling facility would be needed. In fiscal year 2025 the department collected nearly 187,000 tons of textile waste but diverted only about 4.3% of it.
